body_markdown:
**New York, NY –**[Taboola](https://www.taboola.com/) (Nasdaq: TBLA),


a global leader in delivering performance at scale for advertisers,


today ann


ounced that it has been named a ‘Top Tech Provider’ on


[Digiday’s 2026 Top Workplaces](https://digiday.com/announcement/awards/announcing-the-2026-digiday-media-top-workplaces/) list.


**What:** Each year, the Top Workplaces list honors the companies raising the bar across media, marketing, and technology. This year’s honorees share a common thread: a people-first culture, a clear sense of purpose, and a forward-thinking approach to work that drives real business results.


**When:** The winners announcement was made on June 23, 2026.


**Where:** The winners announcement can be found on Digiday’s website


[here.](https://digiday.com/announcement/awards/announcing-the-2026-digiday-media-top-workplaces/)
